messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Paging @oncall — automatic canary promotion triggered for revision `rev-33a7` in us-west at 2026-03-12T12:10:12Z. Canary health checks failing: 5xx rate spike to ~12%, p95 latency from 180ms -> 1.2s. Autoscaler didn't bail because readiness probe returning 200 with empty body. Tagging oncall and runtime.
Jordan (oncall): Taking it. Oncall here — can someone paste the deploy/commit and how much traffic got shifted?
DeployBot: deploy rev-33a7 -> promoted to 10% canary at 12:10:12 by pipeline. Commit: 1f4b2c.
Maria (runtime): Short summary: the new model variant changes the tokenization path; in the runtime we accidentally introduced sync IO on cold start -> long tail latencies. Traffic split was 10% to canary. Traffic router didn't auto-roll back because health check returned HTTP 200 for probe endpoint (probe checks /health but not an inference path).
Kai (sre): Noted. Impact: external customers on hosted-us-west saw degraded responses; synthetic probes SLO alert fired at 12:12. Suggest immediate traffic drain off the canary and either force a rollback or re-route to previous variant.
Jordan (oncall): Plan: 1) Drain traffic from canary to 0% on router 2) If drain completes, keep previous revision active and monitor for 10m 3) If drain stuck, trigger control-plane manual rollback to rev-33a6. Sam, you can run the drain? I'll coordinate with CS on customers.
Sam (eng): Starting drain now. Gateway command: ```
# reduce traffic to canary
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/traffic-split \
  -d '{"service":"inference-us-west","from":"rev-33a7","to_percent":0}'
```
Sam (eng): Running. Gateway shows throttle, now changing routing weight -> setting canary to 0%.
Maria (runtime): While Sam drains, please also flip the feature flag `inference.token-sync-fix` to off (we rolled a gate that ended up being no-op for probe). LD path: https://flags.company/flags/inference.token-sync-fix.
Jordan (oncall): Kai, can you watch the alerts and hold paging? Mark incident as active.
Kai (sre): Watching. Suppressing noisy alerts for the canary group, leaving customer-facing SLOs active.
Sophie (cs): Heads up — CS seeing 5 customer reports, mostly timeouts and "service unavailable". Working with top 3 to confirm mitigation steps and share timeline.
Sam (eng): Drain hit 0% at 12:14:37. Gateway metrics show canary requests -> 0. Error rate for service is back down to baseline (~0.6%) at 12:16.
Maria (runtime): Great. Running a quick smoke test against rev-33a6: ```
# smoke
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq '.text'
``` Responds in ~120ms, okay.
Jordan (oncall): Verification checklist (do in parallel):
- Sam: confirm no lingering canary pods/instances and no half-open connections.
- Maria: run 5x synthetic inference across customers' typical prompts.
- Kai: monitor p95/p99, 5xx for next 10m.
- Sophie: send customer note that we rolled traffic back and are monitoring.
Sam (eng): No canary tasks left, all instances for rev-33a7 terminated on infra side at 12:15:10. Netstat shows no lingering client sockets.
Maria (runtime): Ran 5 synthetic prompts covering short/long sequences, all within thresholds. Perf: p95 170ms, p99 320ms.
Kai (sre): p95 steady at ~180ms, 5xx under 0.5% for 6 minutes. Cancelling escalation.
Sophie (cs): Sent an outbound to impacted customers with timeline and mitigation steps. 1 customer asked for incident ticket — opened INC-2026-432.
Jordan (oncall): Root cause notes in short: change introduced sync IO in tokenization cold path causing tails; health probe didn't exercise inference path so automatic rollback didn't trigger. Action items: update deploy probe to include a lightweight inference check, add a canary guard on sync IO, add a test to CI.
Maria (runtime): I'll open PRs: one to fix tokenization path (runtime), one to update probe and one to add CI test.
Sam (eng): Also recommend adding an automated traffic-drain fallback if p95>500ms for 2m.
Jordan (oncall): Good. Incident state: mitigation complete. Will keep monitoring for 30m. Postmortem owner: Maria. Follow-ups assigned.
IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: Incident marked RESOLVED by Jordan (oncall) at 2026-03-12T12:45:00Z (mitigation window: 35m). Please file postmortem and link INC-2026-432.
Sophie (cs): Adding note to the customer ticket with resolution and ETA for fix.
Kai (sre): Add runbook entry: when canary p95 climbs with low probe failures, prefer draining traffic instead of relying on automated rollback if probe mismatch suspected. I'll draft and PR. :memo:
Jordan (oncall): Thanks all — nice quick coordination. Closing thread once postmortem is up. :thumbsup:
